concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-payment-methods-cards-react-native-component]] — 2026-09-15 React Native Card Component supplement for card settings, brand/funding presentation and token examples; storage-switch snippet conflicts with its prose and no wrapper package version is pinned.
warnings: The guide instructs showStorePaymentField: true but the adjacent code sets false; avoid treating that snippet as a valid consent UI.
One-click stored-card CVC sample uses shopperInteraction: ContAuth; do not infer a general shopper-initiated rule or payment completion.
The webpage does not pin a @adyen/react-native release and does not document complete Sessions/Advanced or 3DS action handling.
